overall_reason: Product-literate copy (budget guards, relay.yaml, retry on tool timeout) is poured into the stock dark-SaaS skeleton: indigo-on-black Linear look, caps eyebrows, six icon-tile cards, unsourced stat band, three tiers with MOST POPULAR, CTA band and link-farm footer, six stock sections in stock order.

findings.evidence: Failed T-STOCK-ORDER: hero with product mock (terminal) > 6 equal feature cards with icon tiles > 4-figure stat band > [config block, not stock] > three pricing tiers with 'MOST POPULAR' > boxed CTA band 'Put your agents to work — with a leash.' > 4-column link-farm footer. Six stock sections in stock order; with near-black ground, a single indigo accent (#5e6ad2) and Inter throughout, it is the dark-single-accent family assembled as a kit.
findings.after: Keep the terminal and the relay.yaml block (the two real things) and build the page around them: e.g. let the config block be the hero's second half, replace the six cards with an annotated run trace, drop the stat band and the closing CTA box.
findings.why: Specific words on a default skeleton are still a default page (T-STOCK-ORDER caps the read at mixed; the look-family cluster pushes it to generated).

findings.evidence: Failed T-RIVAL-NAME: 'Ship agent workflows with confidence', 'Everything your agents need, nothing they don't' and 'Start free. Scale when you're ready.' stay true for any agent-ops vendor (LangSmith, Langfuse, AgentOps). These are the three generic lines from T-FRESH-READER, and two of them are the hero and a section head.
findings.after: Lead with the specific promise the body already makes: 'Every agent run gets a budget, a trace and a retry. No loop rewrite.'
findings.why: The headings could sit on a competitor's page; the specific claims are buried in 14px card text.

findings.evidence: Failed T-DELETION: each card opens with a 36px tile holding a Unicode glyph (⌁ ◉ ↻ ▤ ⇄ ⚑) at about 12px in indigo. Removing them loses nothing; ⌁ and ◉ do not depict routing or observability. Six equal cards in a 3x2 grid with one radius and one border.
findings.after: Drop the icon tiles; vary the cards by content (a mini trace for observability, the budget YAML line for budget guards), or turn the six into a two-column list.
findings.why: Icon tiles above every card heading are the saas-card-kit tell (SLP-003, SLP-005).

findings.evidence: Sub-line says 'Four primitives cover the full lifecycle of a production agent run' directly above six cards. The count was not checked against the content.
findings.before: Four primitives cover the full lifecycle…
findings.after: 'Six primitives…', or regroup into four and say which.
findings.why: A count that disagrees with what is shown is a tell of assembled, unreviewed copy and costs credibility.

findings.evidence: Failed T-FILLER: 'Sign in', 'Get started', all three pricing buttons, 'Get started free' and 11 of 13 footer links point to '#'. 'Read the docs →' goes to #features, not docs. 'Privacy · Terms · Security' is a plain span, not links. The footer is a link farm of destinations that do not exist.
findings.after: Ship only links with real targets; cut Roadmap/Careers/Blog/Status until they exist; make the legal items real links. [DATA NEEDED: actual URLs]
findings.why: Chrome that pretends to a company that is not there is filler and an honesty issue.

findings.evidence: Sweep flagged the band as unsourced; the judgment adds that '12ms p95 overhead per decision' reuses the terminal's 'p95 latency 12ms' for a different measure, and '99.99% … without intervention' sits beside a 'Human in the loop' card. The figures read as decoration, not measurement.
findings.after: One figure with its source and date, or remove the band. [DATA NEEDED: measured figures, method, as-of date]
findings.why: Invented-looking metrics in a stat band are the strongest integrity tell on a SaaS page.

strengths: The terminal transcript and the relay.yaml config are specific to this product (budget flag, deepseek-v4 routing, retry on tool timeout, checkpoint resume) and are the page's best material; any rewrite should promote them, not cut them.
Feature body copy names concrete mechanisms ('When the budget is gone, the run stops — never silently overruns').
not_investigated: brief: no 00-contract.md, so whether the indigo-on-black look is a declared brand could not be checked
eyebrows, em dashes, Inter display, type ladder: reported by the sweep, not repeated
